cross_review_notes: THE TRANSLATION GAP IS INVERTED FROM THE USUAL WORRY. Real money did not lose anything this window because it did not trade - zero closes, one trade in the last 7 days (-$0.99). The paper book lost -$42,139.71. So the honest read is not 'paper is green, live is red' but 'live is not participating', and the paper mirror is telling us the strategies would have lost badly.

DECISION QUALITY AND EXECUTION QUALITY DISAGREE SHARPLY, and only measuring the first would have missed it. Grades were B:9 C:7 D:1 with entry_quality optimal on 9 of 17 - the decisions look fine. Meanwhile mean giveback across ict_scalp is 1.92R and 7 of 10 closes never touched a stop or target. This is exactly the blind spot the execution_capture mandate was added to catch.

TWO INDEPENDENT PATHS ARE BOTH MIS-PRICING NETTED POSITIONS, which raises the odds of a shared root cause. On the REALIZED side, bybit_1 journal-vs-exchange qty diverges 451x on SOLUSDT and 2.45x on BNBUSDT (BL-20260801). On the UNREALIZED side, ib_paper MGC/MES uPnL is off by 3-4 orders of magnitude. Different broker, different code path, same shape: a per-row journal quantity or entry applied to a netted exchange position.

89% OF THE PAPER LOSS IS TWO TRADES, so the aggregate flatters and damns in different directions depending on the cut. mgc_pullback_1d -$19,116 and mhg_pullback_1d -$18,343.75 (both ib_paper, both measured, both genuine multi-day futures losses) account for -$37,459.75 of -$42,139.71. Excluding ib_paper the rest of the paper book is -$4,679.96. Both figures are real; neither alone is the story.

THE 08-03 HEALTH REVIEW TRIAGED ~20 BACKLOG ITEMS WITH AN IDENTICAL BOILERPLATE NOTE ('Re-validated ... No live-health regression tied to this item this window'). That is the lazy-triage tell this skill's completion gate exists to stop, and it is worth naming because it made those rows look worked when they were only touched. This run gave every one of the 57 open items an item-specific disposition, and recorded 'no evidence this window' explicitly where that was the truth rather than dressing it as a re-validation.

A CONCURRENT SESSION (metis-ml2-cell-audit-cont-6ewta2) was live throughout this review and did the trainer/regime work. Their findings are folded in here by reference, not re-derived, and their PR #8584 is still open. The health backlog was the one shared file; I claimed it on the coordination board and got no objection.
